book.name: Tutui laꞌeneu sososan
book.title: Tutui laꞌeneu sososan Mulai neme Manetualain Ana tao lalai no daebafok

content: Boe ma, Isak noke Yakob, boe ma ana feen babaꞌe-babatik ma nanolin, nae, “Mamanene neulalau! O boso sao inana Kanaꞌan.
Tehuu o muni Padan Aram
muu, nai baꞌim Betuel uman. O muu sao mala toꞌom Laban ana inanan esa.
Manetualain Mana Koasa Manai Lain fee babaꞌe-babatik neu o, fo o umbu-ana mala ala boe lamanoꞌu, ma o numbu-saꞌdu mala dadik hataholi nusak fo ana seli.
Manetualain hehelun neu Abraham ana konda neu o numbu-saꞌdu mala. O maena dae fo Manetualain Ana helu feen neu Abraham so.”
Kokolak basa leo ndia, boe ma Isak mboꞌi Yakob neni Padan Aram neu, neni toꞌon Laban ma baꞌin Betuel uman neu.
Esau sao Ismael ana feꞌon
Esau namanene lae Isak fee Yakob babaꞌe-babatik so, ma ana kaꞌin taa bole sao inana Kanaꞌan. Ndia boe oo namanene lae, ndia aman nadenu fadin neu sao toꞌon ana inanan esa, nai Padan Aram.
Basa de Yakob namanene aman ma inan palendan, de ana laꞌo neni Padan Aram neu.
No leondiak, Esau boe oo bubuluk nae, aman taa hii sao nala fo hataholi Kanaꞌan asa.
De, Esau neni ama inahuun Ismael neu, boe ma ana sao bali nala, Ismael anan, nade Mahalat. Mahalat ndia, na, Nebayot feton.
Yakob nalameꞌi neme Betel
Boe ma, Yakob laꞌo ela Beer Syeba, de sangga neni Haran neu.
Ledoeik ledo tesa, boe ma ana losa mamanak esa, de ana sunggu neu ndia. Ledoeik ana sangga sunggu, ana haꞌi nala batu esa, de ana taon daꞌdik neu kailunu.
Leꞌodaen ndia, ana nalameꞌi, nita edak esa nambadeik neu dae, ma mbedan losa lalai. Boe ma, Manetualain ata nala leme nusa-sodak mai, ala konda-hene edak ndia.
Nai meꞌis ndia, Yakob nita LAMATUAK nambadeik nai ndia boboan, boe ma Ana kokolak, nae, “Au ia LAMATUAK, fo o baꞌim Abraham no amam Isak Manetualain. Dei fo Au fee o ma o numbu-sadu mala dae ia.

Dei fo o numbu-sdu mala noꞌun leo afu ia. Ma dei fo ala latanggenggelak leni sudi bee leu, nai basa mamanak lalaꞌen. Neme o numbu-saꞌdu mala mai, dei fo hataholi nusak noꞌu kala lai daebafok, ala hambu babaꞌe-babatik.
Masanenedak neulalau! O muni sudi bee muu, na, Au sama-sama ua o, ma Au anea o. Dei fo Au ua falik o muni nusak ia mai. Au taa ela o mesang. Ma dei fo Au tao atetu basa Au hehelung neu o.”
Yakob foꞌa leondia, boe ma nae, “Bei fo au bubuluk ae, LAMATUAK nai ia boe!”
Ma ana bii, de ana duduꞌa, nae, “Wei! Mamanak ia, tao nala au aong mumulu. Neu ko Manetualain uman nai ia! Ma ia, lelesun neni nusa-sodak neu.”

Foꞌa fafain, boe ma Yakob foꞌa, de, ana haꞌi nala batu fo ana paken dadik kailunu ndia, nambadedei kana fo ana dadik neu tanda nasanenedak. Boe ma, ana diꞌa mina neu batu ndia lain, de ana nakaluku-nakatele neu Lamatuak.
Ana foi mamanak ndia, nade Betel, fo ndandaan nae, ‘Lamatuak uman’. (Makahulun, mamanak ndia, nade Lus.)
Basa ndia, boe ma Yakob soo, nae, “Mete ma Manetualain sama-sama no au, ma nanea au nai au dalang ia, ma Ana fee au nanaꞌak ma baloꞌa papakek,
losa au fali ua sodak, na, dei fo Lamatuak dadik neu au Manetualaing.
Batu fo au ambadedein ia, dadik mamana nakaluku-nakatelek neu Manetualain. Ma basa hata fo Manetualain fee au, dei fo au fee fali kasa babaꞌek esa neme sanahulu mai.”

footnotes.text: Padan Aram ndia, ndia Mesapotamia, nai nusa Siria boboan kii, dekak no Iraq. Haran ndia, na, kota nai Padan Aram.
